_reviewProvenance: Full tier for a breaking release: both directions, the manifest's 54 checkers (Direction A over the 49 brief docs, Direction B over the 5 surfaces), each run twice as a pair, an Opus 5.5 agent and a Sonnet 5.5 agent, each reading its prompt verbatim from a file holding the manifest's pinned context and direction template filled for its item. Run by hand through the host's agent tool in 13 groups, each group run as an Opus 5.5 and a Sonnet 5.5 agent, at most 6 agents at a time. The checkers read an exact export of 8d84aac7bf9062ebae1bc9ea733b129f066e5db1 (this receipt names df4575c9753249328ff17c4b8b870467383d0112; provenanceExtra states the difference) with the binary built from it. Findings were merged by the detector's merge (the finding's where plus the first sixty characters of its claim, first kept): Opus raised 27 and Sonnet raised 9, 35 merged, 26 from Opus alone and 8 from Sonnet alone. 7 merged findings repeating another were folded into the finding they repeat. Each remaining finding was re-verified against df4575c9753249328ff17c4b8b870467383d0112. 28 remain: 26 fixed, 1 invalid on re-verification, and 1 deferred, each to its own open record, 1 of them to records captured at earlier releases that still hold the same finding. The checkers read R1 8d84aac7bf9062ebae1bc9ea733b129f066e5db1. R1 was reverted on the release branch, the brief findings were fixed in 2854547b and b456024c (two Opus+Sonnet docs-currency re-checks, both PROMOTE at b456024c), iss-2611052230577572 was resolved in 07134944, the changelog and release page were recomposed for the docs-currency findings, and R2 was rolled. R2 differs from R1 in 27 files: brief chapters, commands/build.md, docs/explanation/README.md, docs/reference/cli/commands.md, .abcd/work/brief-review-flags.json, the resolved issue record, CHANGELOG.md, RELEASE.md, the plugin pin, the release digest, and two help strings in internal/surface/cli (build.go, drain.go); no behaviour changed. Coverage limits the checkers stated are in each return's coverage note (long chapters 34-build, 35-drain, 17-guard, 37-reserve and 03-configuration were scanned for surface claims in part).
